- Flammable gas generation (C): Certain reactions between metals and explosives might release flammable gases.
- Heat generation (D): Exothermic reactions can occur, generating heat.
- Toxic gas generation (H): Toxic metals can react to form harmful gases.
- Solubilization of toxic substance (G): Toxic substances might become more soluble in certain conditions, posing environmental risks.
